assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage protection and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use; the empty constraints.geojson is deliberate.
assumptions.impact: The package is reviewable for provided provisional boundaries and submitted design layers only; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All submitted site boundary and key-area polygons are provisional (official_boundary=false). They support design discussion, self-check and visualization only.
assumptions.impact: Area, land use, buildings, roads, green/public space, phasing and metrics must be recalculated after official polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: External case studies are used only for transferable mechanisms (governance, pilot, exit, verification); no local figures, investment, enterprise lists or performance are imported.
assumptions.impact: Case citations do not constitute local planning, approval, funding or implementation conclusions.

assumptions.statement: All text-bearing figures are generated in Chinese and English pairs by the declared agent; they are explanatory diagrams derived from the same geometry and metrics, not raw GIS or debug maps.
assumptions.impact: Figures must be regenerated together with geometry and metrics after any official boundary replacement.

assumptions.statement: A3 booklet and A0 boards are generated as real multi-page PDFs from the same figure set; they are concept/professional-deepening materials, not statutory drawings.
assumptions.impact: PDFs must be refreshed whenever figures or metrics change.
